svg.text: With NFRQ=0x00 the steps of the f band come in identical pairs
The step stays 8 samples wide in both f-band panels. A red mark is a boundary where the level barely moved (< 0.5 dB):
only the middle panel has one at every other boundary.
Grey: captured samples, linear amplitude. Blue: carrier level of each step [dB], 0 dB = LFO value 0.
Shaded band = one step; thin gridlines = 8 samples. All panels and all three figures share the same scales.
